key_errors: COMPARATION FAILED! abs_threshold: 0.050000 rel_threshold: 0.010000 incorrect elem counter: 12 among 128 shapes.
Coordinate with max diff: [0,104] Expected: 17.5101 Actual: 2221.72 Diff: 2204.21
root_cause: PR #37141 adds RoPEFusionLtxVideo on CPU and a new RoPEExecutorLtxVideo. The transformation_pipeline.cpp changes enable RoPEFusionLtxVideo. This appears to inadvertently alter how Conv1x1WeightCompressedToMatmul transformations interact, causing catastrophic numerical errors (expected ~17.5, actual ~2221) in a f32/i4 weight-compressed conv-to-matmul test. The deviation is far too large to be a precision issue and indicates incorrect data flow — likely the RoPE transformation is being applied to the wrong subgraph or is interfering with the weight decompression path for the matmul.
reproduction_steps: Run: smoke_Conv1x1WeightCompressedToMatmul_TransposeInput/Conv1x1WeightCompressedToMatmulTest.Inference with IS=[?.1.1.128] ([1.1.1.128].[3.1.1.128]) Cout=128 in=Transpose out=Reshape actPrec=f32 wPrec=i4 device=CPU
recommended_actions: Revert or narrow the scope of RoPEFusionLtxVideo enablement in transformation_pipeline.cpp to ensure it only matches genuine LTX-Video RoPE subgraphs
Add a stricter pattern guard in the RoPEFusionLtxVideo matcher to not match conv weight decompression subgraphs
Run the Conv1x1WeightCompressedToMatmul test suite before re-merging PR #37141
prevention_strategies: When enabling new subgraph fusions in the CPU transformation pipeline, always run the full Conv1x1WeightCompressedToMatmul and FullyConnected weight-compression test suites to catch pattern match collisions.
historical_context: First occurrence of this specific pattern. Numerical magnitude of error (expected ~17, actual ~2221) suggests transformation incorrectly applied to wrong subgraph rather than precision rounding.
